scope: Current published Logic screenshots, compared against the live Mac renderer on 2026-10-31

reference.asset: Current listing Session Players image; exact URL and SHA retained in the visual-preview source manifest
reference.scaleNote: Image normalized by 0.5 for comparison; this is not proof of native point sizes or a fresh capture for every Logic release
reference.sampleNote: Dominant RGB samples from flat image patches; JPEG values rounded to stable neutral roles

implementationChoices.trackHeightNote: Logic track height is configurable. 48 CSS pixels accommodates actual stereo peaks and controls; this is not a claim that all reference rows have this height
implementationChoices.waveformGain: One bounded display gain across both channels; no playback or export processing
implementationChoices.icons: Independently authored SVGs and neutral controls; no Apple artwork or proprietary font bundled
implementationChoices.appearance: System following, with existing explicit light/dark choices preserved

remainingDifferences: Different musical session, files and playback state; no whole-screen pixel similarity claim
